svg.title: Component · Library banner · unreadable · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors LibraryUnreadableBanner in App/LetsLapseApp.swift — the card over every tab, on every platform, while Projects/library.json could not be decoded at launch: the manifest was moved aside as library.json.unreadable-<stamp> (nothing overwrites it — every grade, tag and blend record is in that file) and every write is refused until the app is relaunched against a repaired or restored one (data model Phase 1, W7). The first sentence is the decoder's own reason. phone is a 393pt screen less 14pt each side; window the macOS default 760pt window less the same.

g.text: Library not loaded — nothing is being saved
The data couldn’t be read because it isn’t in the
correct format. The manifest was set aside as
Projects folder; every grade, tag and blend record is
still in it. Quit, repair or restore it, and relaunch.
